messages:
andre: quick sync — spotted weirdness in role assign flow when route-level quotas exist. created a tiny repro.

mira: repro? link?

andre: https://redwood.internal/issue/3240 small video. steps: create role R with scope 'route:api/v1/generate', attach quota 100 qpm, then assign to tenant via console → UI shows "can call" toggle, but traffic still routed to fallback model for that route.

sanjay: @mira @laura is this the permissions check or routing policy mismatch?

laura: likely routing. when scope present we attach quota policy id to token and routing uses that. if UI omits policy binding we send token without quota, fallback triggers.

jen: can we add telemetry to confirm token payload? maybe a token-debug header.

andre: I added a tiny telemetry flag in the repro: header x-perm-debug: true — logs show missing 'route_quota_id'

mira: suspicious — UI assign flow calls POST /admin/roles/:id/bindings then PATCH /tenants/:id/scopes — could be race when both calls happen.

sanjay: yep race or optimistic UI. Console does parallel requests to cut latency. If bindings persist slower then tenant gets stale view.

laura: simple fix: make ensureBindingsAtomic endpoint on backend that accepts all changes in one transaction.

jen: backend change ok but we'd prefer client fix first. maybe disable parallelism for route-scoped binds and show a micro-loading state.

andre: agreed — but product asked for snappy assign UX. compromise: optimistic UI but poll until manifest confirmed; show small spinner on the specific role row.

mira: also add an audit telemetry event when assign completes with payload sample (no secrets) — helps debug in future.

perms-bot: note created: perms.audit.event id=ae-324000 created by andre

laura: API change idea: return manifest_version in assign response; client can wait for manifest_version to be visible in GET tenant before marking done.

jen: that is elegant. lower friction for frontend and no global lock.

sanjay: corner case: what if manifest builds are async and take >5s? client should fallback to polling with exponential backoff.

andre: RBAC UI followups: add microcopy explaining "route-level quotas take ~10s to propagate" — reduces support pings.

mira: can someone file a small ticket for api change + frontend poll + telemetry? I'll triage.

andre: filed: https://redwood.internal/issue/3241 - assign-flow: atomicity + poll + telemetry

jen: I'll take frontend PR. will add a 1s debounce then poll up to 8s.

laura: I'll draft backend PR for manifest_version in response.

sanjay: add unit test simulating delayed manifest apply.

mira: awesome. thanks team :tada:

andre: thanks all — will follow up in PR comments.
